region.name: Western Kansas GMD 1, 3 and 4 (26 counties)
region.method: Acre-weighted median over the region's groundwater-irrigated points of diversion of each point's p10 / p50 / p90 years left.

method: Per field: saturated thickness (kriged winter 2024-2026 water level minus aquifer base at wells) and weather-normalised 2011-2026 decline rate (local-linear-trend Kalman filter, kriged), Monte Carlo (2000 draws) over kriging + aquifer-base uncertainty and decadal decline variability. County value = acre-weighted median of its irrigated points' p10/p50/p90. 100 = 100 or more years (rising or flat).
